name: NGC 147
tagline: An Andromeda dwarf spheroidal 2.53 Mly out — old stars, quiet gas, orbiting in M31's gravitational grip.
history: NGC 147 is one of Andromeda's more substantial dwarf satellites — a diffuse spheroidal of old and intermediate-age stars about 150,000 light-years from M31's disc in projection. Its orbital history is still being mapped by proper-motion surveys, but its diffuse tidal outskirts suggest it has already passed close to the giant once. It forms a close pair on the sky with its sibling NGC 185.
